title: Humanvoice source snapshot
description: An immutable read-only capture of a source tree plus the validated authoring brief. Per implementation contract trust_boundary T1, all compilation reads from a snapshot and writes only to a separate scratch directory; the snapshot itself is never modified after creation.

snapshot_id.description: Stable identifier for this snapshot, e.g. snapshot-20260828-141530

source_hash.description: SHA-256 over the snapshot contents. For a single file, the file digest; for a tree, the digest of per-file digests in sorted path order.

source_files.description: Snapshot-relative paths of captured source files, e.g. source/intro.tex. Paths are relative and must not escape the snapshot root.

brief.description: The authoring brief captured with the snapshot. Its own required fields are enforced by authoring-brief.schema.json when the brief is stored as a standalone record.

brief_valid.description: Whether the brief passed completeness validation at snapshot time. A snapshot with an invalid brief cannot support a release.

snapshot_immutable.description: Asserts the snapshot is closed to modification. A snapshot record can only claim immutability; the value is never false.

source_root.description: Absolute path of the original source tree, recorded for provenance. Never read during compilation.

scratch_path.description: Snapshot-relative path of the writable scratch directory used for builds

file_digests.description: Optional per-file SHA-256 map keyed by snapshot-relative path, enabling per-file integrity checks without recomputing the tree

byte_size.description: Total bytes captured, checked against operating_envelope.max_source_tree_mib

privacy_class.description: Handling class inherited from the brief; governs what may appear in a reader packet
